row.notes: mov [rsp+0x58],r9 in Ne_MemoryMap_CreateHeap (0x14396e9d0), right before the call to Ne_MemoryMap_AllocHeapBlock (0x14396f145). r9 = the heap's size in bytes after the virtualExpandPercent scaling (stock AUDIO_BUNDLE: 45088768 = 43M); the spill at [rsp+0x58] feeds the heap object's capacity at every later construction path (mov rdx,[rsp+0x58]), so writing r9 here resizes the allocation and the heap together. rdi = the heap config struct (+0x4 virtual, +0x20 pagesize). The name is in the frame as scrambled byte slots: char k of the name at rsp+{0x60,0x6f,0x6a,0x6e,0x64,0x6d,0x68,0x6c,0x80,0xa7,0x9c,0xa6,0x90,0xa5,0x9a,0xa4,0x78,0xa3,0x98,...}. Reached once per HEAP element while system/memory_map.xml loads (Boot_Load_SystemConfig); only the early stage (CreateMutexW trigger) is before it.
